question: Can the frozen V6.1 ranks be converted into stronger net portfolios when shorts are optional, rank magnitudes are treated conservatively, and trading is persistent?

formation.alpha_gate: Strictly positive calibrated alpha for longs and strictly negative calibrated alpha for alpha shorts; holding bands apply to return rank, not to the alpha sign.
formation.opposing_signal_rule: An inherited holding may be reduced or closed but never flipped in the same month.
formation.short_rule: Shorts are permitted but never required. New alpha shorts must clear stressed round-trip trading and one-month borrow costs. Separate zero-alpha hedge shorts may be used only to satisfy risk limits and are capped in aggregate.

rank_to_payoff.direct_rank: Use tail rank strength and one causal side-level payoff scale; do not estimate stock-specific return magnitudes.
rank_to_payoff.shrunk_linear: Fit one causal nonnegative rank-payoff slope plus intercept with equal month weights and ridge shrinkage.

optimizer.objective: maximize causal expected monthly stock excess return minus trading, financing, and borrow costs subject to a forecast-risk ceiling

evaluation.primary_metric: realized annualized net Sharpe under primary costs
report: gross, net, factor, industry, capacity, and breadth
comparison_controls: V6.1 Step 02 joint-alpha optimized 10 percent volatility
V6.1 Step 02 FF5-only optimized 10 percent volatility
